name: Validation - Year Below Minimum
goal: User selects 'Others', enters year below 2018, is re-prompted, then enters valid year.
constraints: User selects 'Others', enters 2017, is re-prompted, then enters 2018. Delivery preference: email.

phases.description: Run setup workflow and confirm menuType is 'only years'.

phases.completionCriteria: Bot rejects input and re-prompts for year.

phases.description: User selects 'Get the letter via email'.
phases.completionCriteria: Bot triggers workflow and returns 'We have triggered the appraisal letter to your email.'

manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user
